summary: Kaniksu National Forest L-4 lookout: 1932 cabin, 1934 40-ft pole tower with firefinder; destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes the site today.

facts.destroyed: 1950s (decade only; no single year in any of the three pages)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

events.note: 40-ft pole tower with L-4 cab. Firefinder about 1/4 mile south.

evidence.supports: 1932 cabin preceded a 40-ft L-4 tower built in 1934
evidence.quote: Preceded by a 1932 cabin, this 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934,

evidence.supports: Firefinder described as a patrol firefinder on Kemnow's page
Location four miles north of Nordman

evidence.quote: There was also a firefinder 1/4 mile south.

evidence.supports: Firefinder 1/4 mile south on Idaho Fire Lookouts page
evidence.quote: There was also a firefinder 1/4 mile south.

corrections.proposed: destroyed in the 1950s; no single year is given
corrections.why: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Kemnow each give only the 1950s. The record's 1950 is more precise than any source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's coordinates (48.69167, -116.93953), taken from idaho_fl, differ from the FFLA list and firelookout.com (48.69171, -116.92921). The two points are about 0.76 km apart. The sources do not settle which is right, so the record keeps one point and the difference is flagged here.

sources.title: Granite Mountain - Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Ron Kemnow, Forest Lookouts western US

notes_for_editor: Destruction is decade-only (1950s) in all three pages, so the record's 1950 is proposed as a correction and no destroyed event is dated. The record location (idaho_fl) differs from the FFLA/firelookout.com point by about 0.76 km. Do not confuse with the NHLR Granite Mountain entries for Salmon NF or Payette NF, which are different towers. No staffing sources and no site-today source.
